## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Marathahalli) firm offering silicon-engineering services today, with a stated product line of die-to-die PHY IP and HPC chiplets.

## What does this firm design?

Die-to-die PHY interface IP and chiplets for HPC and data centres.
